RedWallet refresh hotfix

Fixes "Batch limit exceeded" during wallet refresh and watch-only history loading. Servers rejecting a batch are queried one item at a time on the same authenticated connection. Other errors still propagate. Update and refresh your existing wallet; no re-import is required for this fix.

RedWallet Taproot: cold signing and fee bumping

BIP86 Taproot watch-only accounts can now create PSBT requests and verify returned signed PSBTs. External signing is opt-in and requires an XBT-capable signer that supports Unified SIGHASH 0x21. Signed returns are checked against the exact reviewed transaction, authenticated input amounts and scripts, and Schnorr signatures before broadcast. Return a signed PSBT; raw signed transaction hex is unsupported. Signing requests belong to the current app session; after restarting the app or replacing a request, create and sign a fresh request.

Raise the fee of an eligible unconfirmed outgoing transaction with RBF. Original inputs and recipient amounts stay unchanged; the extra fee comes from change. An unconfirmed received output can fund a CPFP child, with its fee calculated for the parent plus child together. Hot-wallet fee bumps show the actual fee and honor enabled biometric authentication and high-fee confirmations. Enrolled watch-only accounts return through the external PSBT signing flow.

Limitations: ordinary Bitcoin signer firmware is incompatible with XBT Unified signatures. Physical cold-device interoperability and funded physical-phone testing remain unverified. Taproot key-path signing only; no script paths, annexes or multisig. RBF requires replaceability and enough change; cancellation and adding inputs are unsupported. Descendants or stricter node policy may require a higher fee. CPFP supports one unconfirmed parent with confirmed inputs and a spendable owned output. Node acceptance and confirmation are not guaranteed.

Checks include public-vector offline signing/rejection cases on the native engine and independent isolated Knots tests. Keep an offline recovery backup and verify recipient addresses and fees on the signing device.
